basics.name: Alex Schutz
basics.label: Robotics PhD Student
basics.summary: A keen researcher in robotics with a focus on planning and learning in graph-based environments.

work.name: Stateful Robotics
work.summary: Design and development of planning algorithms for robot intelligence in industrial applications.
highlights: Created hierarchical heuristic-powered planning approach for scalable application of MDPs
Delivered key customer deadlines in critical stages of early startup

work.name: University of Oxford
work.summary: Course design and teaching of a week-long practical robotics course for 1st-year PhD students.
highlights: Rewrote course content for new hardware and greatly improved teaching experience
Delivered content concerning ROS, perception, control, planning, SLAM, and MDPs

work.name: Myriota
work.summary: Development of algorithms and software for the operation of satellite hardware in IoT applications.
highlights: Designed software tools using C/C++ and Python for large scale cloud-based simulations
Analysed data from simulation to determine optimal satellite network configurations
Designed solutions to coordinate radio transmissions and receptions on a satellite

awards.title: General Sir John Monash Scholarship
awards.summary: The General Sir John Monash Foundation awards postgraduate scholarships to Australians who demonstrate outstanding leadership potential and who wish to study overseas.

awards.title: Most Outstanding Engineering Student Prize
awards.summary: The Head of School of Mechanical Engineering will award the prize to the final year student who has completed all of the requirements for the degree and achieves the highest weighted average mark including all courses presented towards the degree.

projects.name: Reinforcement Learning on Graphs
projects.summary: A blog post aimed to educate beginners on the fundamentals of applying reinforcement learning to graph-structured data.

projects.name: Scalable planning for Deterministic POMDPs
projects.summary: A fusion of Monte-Carlo Value Iteration and Goal-HSVI to create a goal-oriented solver for Deterministic POMDPs. Published at IJCAI 2025.
